findings.problem: U1 (B:track_001) is the recorder C, which the reconstruction could not align: shown as an anonymous road user, C's own data not replayed
findings.solution: limitation: an observed alignment needs a moving target (phase 1 refused it, correctly ambiguous)

S18/run_0_abreast.summary: Negative case passes: C and D are never one road user.  C is drawn twice (U1 = A:track_001, U2 = B's tracks: a missed merge), D once (U3 = A:track_003 + B:track_003).  A:track_001 starts on D (C and D 1.4 m apart side to side: A's radar clusters their returns) and settles on C: the drift is reconstructed as a CUT_IN_FROM_RIGHT and an EGO_PATH_ENTRY of A on U1 that did not happen.

findings.problem: C drawn as two road users (U1, U2) overlapping: missed merge
findings.solution: fragmentation, the price of conservative gates (fusion metrics: missed merges)

findings.problem: spurious CUT_IN_FROM_RIGHT / EGO_PATH_ENTRY of A on U1: A's track moves from D to C, no vehicle cuts in
findings.solution: local tracker limitation (returns of two cars within the 2 m cluster distance); counted as false positives by the phase-5 semantic evaluation

S18/run_0_passing.summary: Negative case passes: C and D never fused.  D is one road user (U3 = A:track_004 + B:track_003 + B:track_005), C two (U1, U2).  As in abreast, A:track_001 starts on D and settles on C: a spurious CUT_IN_FROM_RIGHT / EGO_PATH_ENTRY of A on U1.

findings.problem: C drawn as two road users (U1, U2): missed merge
spurious CUT_IN_FROM_RIGHT / EGO_PATH_ENTRY of A on U1 (track drifting from D to C)
findings.solution: local tracker limitation; phase-5 false positives

S18/run_0_platoon.summary: Negative case passes: C and D never fused.  D is U1 (A:track_001 + B:track_002 + B:track_004) with a short duplicate U2 (A:track_003) at the start; C is U3 then U4 (fragments).
